stories.title: Trump gathers Cabinet as he looks to seal deal to end war
stories.description: President Trump will meet with his Cabinet on Wednesday at a precarious moment for talks aimed at ending the war with Iran. The emerging deal has already exposed the president to fierce criticism.

stories.title: Prospects fade for imminent end to Iran war as attacks restart
stories.description: Israel says it will intensify attacks against Hezbollah in Lebanon and U.S. military struck Iranian boats and missile launch sites as envoys continued negotiations for a deal that would end the three-month war.

stories.title: U.S. strikes Iran. And, immigration courts use new tactic to speed up deportations
stories.description: The U.S. military has launched new attacks on Iran while talks to end the conflict are ongoing. And, the Department of Justice is using a new tactic in immigration courts to accelerate deportations.
